name: Cryo / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A frozen limb breaks cleanly: a single sharp brittle ice and bone crack with a compact crunchy snap, four small ice chips scatter and tinkle. No long frost ambience.
